scope: Full-cycle graded 8-cell P2 finite-J2/plane-penalty/periodic-MPC path sensitivity; not a spatial accuracy certificate.
interpretation: Refinement reduces the observed work/energy imbalance at every common station without changing the balance definition.
Final contact force changes by 0.113724%; the largest common-station mean-PEEQ change is 0.015709%.
Both runs have open contact at factors 0.5 and 0.75, and active reference area 0.25 m^2 at 0.25 and 1.0.
This joint initial-increment/plastic-cap refinement does not attribute the effect to either control alone; the separate same-source initial-increment experiment isolates that control.
This is diagnostic evidence, not a retrospective pass/fail tolerance or a continuum error estimate.
The full coarse/refined runtimes are not performance evidence: refinement changes numerical work, and independent short tests overlapped parts of these runs.
Nonuniform spatial accuracy and an equivalent-input independent external reference remain open.
